title: Strict C++-to-Rust Program Port — Lite
summary: Focused, opt-in profile idea for faithfully replacing an existing C++ program with Rust. Reuse language-independent strict-porting requirements from the C-to-Rust Lite draft (PROFILE-0001), including externally observable parity, targeted differential/regression tests, project/repository hygiene, documentation, and privacy. Review C++-specific gaps separately: object lifetime and RAII, ownership and aliasing, exceptions and error propagation, overloads/templates and runtime polymorphism, memory/layout and ABI/FFI boundaries, and threading/concurrency. Do not assume that C-specific atomic rules automatically apply to C++.
